result:
All findings confirmed. Here is the complete answer:

---

**`DashboardController`** declares two directly injected service fields (via `@RequiredArgsConstructor`):

| Role | Service Interface | Concrete Implementation |
|---|---|---|
| Dashboard CRUD + assignment ops | `TbDashboardService` | `DefaultTbDashboardService` |
| Resource export/management | `TbResourceService` | `DefaultTbResourceService` |

*(Note: `DashboardController` also calls `dashboardService`, `userService`, `customerService`, `tenantService`, and `accessControlService` inherited from `BaseController`, but those are not direct field dependencies of `DashboardController` itself.)*

---

RELEVANT_FILES_START
application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/controller/DashboardController.java | The controller under analysis; declares TbDashboardService and TbResourceService as direct @RequiredArgsConstructor-injected fields
application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/entitiary/dashboard/TbDashboardService.java | Service interface for dashboard operations, directly injected into DashboardController
application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/entitiary/dashboard/DefaultTbDashboardService.java | Concrete implementation of TbDashboardService
application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/resource/TbResourceService.java | Service interface for resource operations, directly injected into DashboardController
application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/resource/DefaultTbResourceService.java | Concrete implementation of TbResourceService
RELEVANT_FILES_END
